name: Manav Garima Yojana DCW (Minority)
benefit: 1. The primary benefit is the provision of various business tool-kits to eligible beneficiaries so that they can engage in small business activities and become self-employed and financially self-sufficient. 1. The tool kits are given under the scheme targeted at the minority community.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must belong to the minority community. - The applicant’s family annual income should be ₹ 6,00,000/- or less in general.
